overview: 2026年，JAG通过全资子公司JAG Renewable Energy以RM36,888,000收购Shah Alam一幅约15,016平方米的永久地契工业用地，用于可再生能源业务；同时Jaring Metal Industries与Mitsubishi Materials Corporation的MOU在年内三次状态更新中均无重大进展。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增68.0%至RM101.55百万。
overview_en: In 2026, JAG, through its wholly-owned subsidiary JAG Renewable Energy, proposed to acquire a piece of freehold industrial land in Shah Alam measuring approximately 15,016 square metres for RM36,888,000 for its renewable energy business; meanwhile, the MOU between Jaring Metal Industries and Mitsubishi Materials Corporation showed no material development in three status updates during the year. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue rose 68.0% year-on-year to RM101.55 million.

segments.name: 可再生能源
segments.note: 通过全资子公司JAG Renewable Energy收购Shah Alam工业用地，用于可再生能源业务。
segments.note_en: Through wholly-owned subsidiary JAG Renewable Energy, acquiring industrial land in Shah Alam for the renewable energy business.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 就上述土地收购补充估值资料，估值于2026年8月采用比较法进行，用于融资目的。
actions.text_en: Provided additional information on the land acquisition, including that the valuation was conducted in August 2026 using the comparison approach for financing purposes.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: JAG Renewable Energy与Kobe Steel, Ltd.签订买卖协议，以RM36,888,000收购Shah Alam Hicom Industrial Estate一幅约15,016平方米的永久地契工业用地。
actions.text_en: JAG Renewable Energy entered into a sale and purchase agreement with Kobe Steel, Ltd. to acquire a piece of freehold industrial land measuring approximately 15,016 square metres at Hicom Industrial Estate, Shah Alam, for RM36,888,000.

segments.name: 金属工业
segments.note: 全资子公司Jaring Metal Industries与Mitsubishi Materials Corporation的MOU年内多次更新，均无重大进展。
segments.note_en: The MOU between wholly-owned subsidiary Jaring Metal Industries and Mitsubishi Materials Corporation was updated several times during the year, with no material development.
